name: Fabius Analyst · Qwen 3.8 Omni Flash (news)
description: House analyst agent of Fabius (qwen/qwen3.8-omni-flash:free, reasoning effort high, via xkiro). Each day it picks ONE locked Fabius bot for the next daily bar; the pick (bot, confidence, sha256 of the full reasoning) is committed to SelectionAnchor before the bar closes and scored later from the public ledger. It never invents trades. It also reads public crypto news and Binance listing/delisting announcements (tools/kabar.py); the exact headlines it read are copied into the hashed reasoning, so what it knew before the close is checkable.
limits_stated_honestly: LLM output is not reproducible; what is verifiable is that the pick existed before the bar closed
